title: Software Engineering for LLM-Based Agents: A Lifecycle-Oriented Survey
abstract: arXiv:2611.23260v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based Agents perform tasks through tool use and interaction with external environments. Public engineering guidance commonly begins with a target task, selects a suitable workflow or autonomous Agent design, and refines prompts, tools, and execution strategies using task outcomes, latency, and cost. When delivered as software systems, Agents must also satisfy stakeholder requirements, action boundaries, quality checks, and maintenance needs. Model-directed execution can vary across runs, failures can span model decisions and tools, and changes to prompts, models, or interfaces can affect previously accepted behavior. This survey examines how LLM-based Agents are engineered across five software lifecycle stages: Requirements Engineering, Architecture and Design, Implementation and Integration, Testing and Assurance, and Maintenance and Evolution. translated_title: 面向基于大语言模型智能体的软件工程：一项面向生命周期的综述
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过工具使用和与外部环境的交互来执行任务。公开的工程指导通常从目标任务出发，选择合适的工作流或自主智能体设计，并依据任务结果、延迟和成本来优化提示词、工具和执行策略。当作为软件系统交付时，智能体还必须满足利益相关者的需求、行动边界、质量检查和维护需求。模型指导的执行在不同运行之间可能存在差异，故障可能同时涉及模型决策和工具，而对提示词、模型或接口的更改可能影响此前已被接受的行为。本综述考察了基于LLM的智能体如何在五个软件生命周期阶段进行工程化：需求工程、架构与设计、实现与集成、测试与保障，以及维护与演化。基于355篇论文的主要文献集，我们比较了这些工程……
tldr: 本综述基于355篇论文，从需求工程、架构与设计、实现与集成、测试与保障、维护与演化五个软件生命周期阶段，系统梳理并比较了基于LLM智能体的软件工程方法。
en_tdlr: Based on 355 papers, this survey systematically reviews and compares software engineering practices for LLM-based agents across five lifecycle stages: requirements engineering, architecture and design, implementation and integration, testing and assurance, and maintenance and evolution.
